data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana' meaning 'to charm', Moloy is a name that conveys the feeling of being deeply loved and cherished. The name Moloy carries the meaning “Beloved, Darling” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Moloy usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, darling and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In folk tales and mythology, Moloy is often depicted as a playful and mischievous deity, but also one who brings joy and happiness to those around him. In everyday life, Moloy is a common name given to baby boys in Bengali families, symbolizing the hope that they will grow up to be loved, cherished, and able to bring happiness to those around them.
